layers.title: Coal fields
layers.measure: Where coal lies in the ground in the lower 48, by field, with its age and rank, as the U.S. Geological Survey maps it.
layers.terms_quote: USGS-authored or produced data and information are considered to be in the U.S. Public Domain. [...] When using information from USGS information products, publications, or websites, we ask that proper credit be given.
layers.value_label: area of the coal field (computed on a sphere from the source's polygon, square kilometres over 2.589988110336; AREA_KM2 holds the square kilometres)
layers.source_title: Coal fields of the conterminous United States, National Coal Resource Assessment updated version (Open-File Report 2012-1205, East 2013), Updated Coal Fields/Coal_Fields.shp
layers.reduction: each polygon simplified to 0.01 degrees with its topology kept (Douglas-Peucker, one feature at a time); coordinates to 3 decimals; no feature dropped
layers.acknowledgment: Source: U.S. Geological Survey, Open-File Report 2012-1205 (2013)
layers.notes_for_method: An outline of where coal fields lie and their rank, not a measure of coal in place or of what can be mined.
